info.title: webpx — Darnelix.Webp command-line tool
info.description: webpx is the command-line front end for Darnelix.Webp, a pure-C#, dependency-free WebP codec: encode, decode, inspect (info), edit containers (mux/demux), and build or extract animations — all on the same managed codec, with no native code and zero runtime dependencies.

commands.name: anim
commands.description: Build an animated WebP from frames, or extract its frames.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output animated .webp (required).
Output pattern with one %d placeholder, e.g. frame_%03d.pam (required).

options.name: --loop
options.description: Loop count 0..65535 (0 = forever). Default 0.

options.name: --bgcolor
options.description: ANIM background-color hint. Default 255,255,255,255.

options.name: --in-format
options.description: pam|ppm|pgm|pnm|bmp|raw for every frame (else per-file extension).

options.name: --width
options.description:
Raw input geometry (raw frames only): gray|rgb|rgba|bgr|bgra.
Per-frame options (sticky — apply to all following frames until changed):

options.name: --duration
options.description: Frame display duration. Default 100.

options.name: --lossless
options.description: Encode following frames losslessly (VP8L).

options.name: --quality
options.description: Per-frame quality. Default 75.

options.name: --method
options.description:
Per-frame effort. Default 4.
The first frame fixes the canvas size; every frame must be that size.

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Decode a WebP file to a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or raw raster.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path (alternative to the second argument).

options.name: --out-format
options.description: pam | ppm | pgm | pnm | bmp | raw (else inferred from the extension).

options.name: --format
options.description:
rgba | bgra | argb | rgb | bgr. The decoded pixel layout.
Written verbatim for raw; for BMP/.pnm only its alpha
presence is used; PAM/PPM/PGM have a fixed layout.

options.name: --crop
options.description: Decode only this source sub-region.

options.name: --scale
options.description: Resize the (cropped) image to W x H.

options.name: --flip
options.description: Write the image bottom-up (vertical flip).

options.name: --first-frame
options.description:
For an animated input, decode its first frame as a still
(otherwise animated input is rejected).

commands.name: demux
commands.description: List a WebP container's chunks/frames, or extract a metadata payload.

options.name: --get
options.description: Extract that metadata chunk's payload (requires -o).

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output path for --get.
With no --get, prints a chunk/frame listing to stdout.

commands.name: encode
commands.description: Encode a PAM/PPM/PGM, BMP, or raw raster to a WebP file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path (alternative to the second argument).

options.name: --in-format
options.description: pam | ppm | pgm | pnm | bmp | raw (else inferred from the extension).

options.name: --width
options.description: Raw input width  (required for raw input).

options.name: --height
options.description: Raw input height (required for raw input).

options.name: --format
options.description: Raw input layout: gray | rgb | rgba | bgr | bgra (required for raw).

options.name: --lossless
options.description: Encode losslessly (VP8L) instead of lossy (VP8).

options.name: --quality
options.description: Quality (higher is better/larger). Default 75.

options.name: --method
options.description: Effort (higher is slower/smaller). Default 4.

options.name: --near-lossless
options.description: Near-lossless preprocessing level (0 = off). Lossless only.

options.name: --alpha-quality
options.description: Alpha-plane compression effort. Default 100.

options.name: --alpha-method
options.description: Alpha compression: 0 = uncompressed, 1 = lossless. Default 1.

options.name: --sharp-yuv
options.description: Use the higher-quality 'sharp' RGB->YUV path. Lossy only.

options.name: --exact
options.description: Preserve RGB under fully-transparent pixels.

options.name: --target-size
options.description: Target output size (two-pass). Lossy only; excludes --target-psnr.

options.name: --target-psnr
options.description: Target reconstruction PSNR (two-pass). Lossy only; excludes --target-size.

options.name: --segments
options.description: Number of VP8 segments (0 = automatic). Lossy only.

options.name: --filter-strength
options.description: Loop-filter strength (0 = off). Lossy only. Default 60.

options.name: --filter-sharpness
options.description: Loop-filter sharpness. Lossy only.

options.name: --passes
options.description: Entropy-analysis passes for token-probability optimization.

options.name: --threads
options.description:
Hint that worker threads may be used (output is identical).
Metadata (ICC/EXIF/XMP) is set with 'webpx mux', not here.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print a WebP file's features (size, format, alpha, animation).

commands.name: mux
commands.description: Set/strip ICC/EXIF/XMP metadata or set animation loop/background color.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path (required).

options.name: --set-icc
options.description: Set/replace the ICC color profile from <file>.

options.name: --set-exif
options.description: Set/replace the EXIF metadata from <file>.

options.name: --set-xmp
options.description: Set/replace the XMP metadata from <file>.

options.name: --strip-icc
options.description: Remove the ICC color profile.

options.name: --strip-exif
options.description: Remove the EXIF metadata.

options.name: --strip-xmp
options.description: Remove the XMP metadata.

options.name: --loop
options.description: Set the animation loop count (0 = forever). Animation only.

options.name: --bgcolor
options.description: Set the animation background color. Animation only.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Set the library log level.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Errors only (log level error).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Verbose logging (log level debug).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help, or a command's help.
